notes.title: August Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! Please take a moment to read over the patch notes. This month a lot of work was done on the back end. This was mainly to get the game out on all platforms so less real new content. I also finished the last of the quality of life (QoL) changes I was aware people wanted. At this point I am moving away from backend stuff and this sort of QoL work and move forward with content being more of the work. I will still address bugs as they come up, and optimizations where I can, but they will take up a much smaller portion of the work.[/p][p]New Content:[/p][p]1.      Finished Localization. As far as I am aware, everything is localized.[/p][p]2.      New Axe Weapons[/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][p]1.      A silly sound spawned when you got to the game over screen… FIXED![/p][p]2.      Fixed FOV resetting with certain items like the spyglass[/p][p]3.      Fixed the Mouse inversion uninverting whenever settings were saved[/p][p]4.      Crashing when transitioning to the mountain area.[/p][p]Looking Ahead:[/p][p]1.      Controller Support is indefinitely on hold[/p][p]2.      A quest in the underground caverns involving a bear[/p][p]3.      More ways to take out the lava golem[/p][p]4.      Fixing the quest involving the lich fight[/p][p]5.      Quest involving the lost Ents and some armor[/p][p]Thanks @everyone![/p][p] [/p][p]-Fleece[/p]

notes.title: July Update
notes.content: [h1]July Update Patch Notes! [/h1][p]Hello everyone! Please take a moment to read over the patch notes. For July I spent some time testing TCL on Unreal 4.27 so I can get it on the Epic Games Store, but still managed to get some good work done:[/p][h2]New Content:[/h2][p]1.      Some more content and a quest located in a later level ||Tartarus is the later level getting the revamp and the quest is more of an event, which is a gauntlet of enemies||[/p][p]2.      A new enemy! [b]The Wasp[/b][/p][p]3.      Some new settings for player preferences: [b]FOV and mouse inversion[/b][/p][p]4.      More Voice over, and added subtitles to VO that didn’t have any[/p][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][p]1.      There was some crashing from enemies dying and the game treating them as alive… FIXED![/p][p]2.      More enemy names and description mixups… FIXED[/p][p]3.      Still working on Optimizations. The game should run a little smoother in general because I have made many of the transitions between areas into their own streaming levels.[/p][h2]Looking Ahead:[/h2][p]1.      August update will be the engine upgrade. If I can’t solve all the problems with the new engine I may have to cancel Epic Games Store[/p][p]2.      [b]Continuing working back from the endings filling out empty areas. Plus Quests!![/b][/p][p]3.      Still hunting down lag spikes loading levels and music[/p][p]4.      Controller Support is still a maybe at this point[/p][p]Thanks @everyone![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924228/d0316a299a9fc2ef792dd599fe2836b0f69c5525.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]-Fleece[/b][/h3]

notes.title: June Update
notes.content: [p]# June Update Patch Notes![/p][p]Hello everyone! Please take a moment to read over the patch notes. Because of unforeseen events the release of my game was missing some of the work I did in late April and May. I have added that and more. Plus, with some of the early feedback I have made changes and fixed some bugs.[/p][p]## New Content:[/p][p]1.      Updated the intro area so It is now more instructive and better lit[/p][p]2.      Most of the voice over is now in the game[/p][p]3.      Some small level tweaks[/p][p]4.      First pass of the localization started. TEXT ONLY[/p][p]## Bug Fixes:[/p][p]1.      Saving and Loading – there was a bug when loading enemies that caused crashing that has been fixed. This should not affect prior save files, but to be safe start a new file. If it continues, please notify me[/p][p]2.      Some enemy’s names and descriptions were pulling incorrectly from a table of values. This should be fixed[/p][p]3.      Some saving and level transition Optimizations[/p][p]## Looking Ahead:[/p][p]1.      I am going to upgrade the engine soon, as it is a requirement for some of the games online presence. I have done it on a separate machine, This may cause new problems but I will be on top of it![/p][p]2.      Further optimizing the game. There are 2 things I would like to address. One is some machines have occasional hitches due to loading music. The other is I am very aware of the large lag spikes between levels and working on it. I have already cut this problem down significantly.[/p][p]3.      More Content!! There are some areas of the game that are more unfinished than others, I am focusing on those most for now. Mostly endgame stuff and will work backwards.[/p][p]4.      Controller Support is a big maybe at this point, but I will start some initial tests in the next couple of months[/p][p]Thanks @everyone![/p][p] [/p][p]**-Fleece**[/p]
